escena: SCENE (after the session, studio in Miami, late afternoon, NOBODY IN FRAME): the room is empty of people — verify it: there is not a single person, hand or body anywhere in the picture. What remains is the trace of the work that just happened: a chair pushed back at an angle from the table, printed layouts still spread where they were left, a marker with its cap off, a half-drunk glass, one lamp still on. A hard low sun beam comes through the window and lands across the empty chair, with dust still drifting in it. The room reads as if the people stepped out a minute ago. 35mm at f/2.8, focus on the empty chair. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the table in shadow against the lens
